metadata.question: Did the Lut Desert experience land surface temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius in 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) collection MOD11A1 for daily 1-km LST, or MYD11A1 as fallback, for year 2018 over the Lut Desert (Iran). 2. Masking strategy: Use the QC band to mask low-quality pixels (keep only “good” & “average” LST pixels). 3. Validation: Check collection size → if 0 → C1. After masking, count valid pixels; if 0 → C2. Compute max LST; if result is None/NaN or outside physical range → C3. If max > 75 °C → A, else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') lut = ee.Geometry.Point(58.2, 30.6) # central Lut Desert col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1')\ .filterBounds(lut).filterDate('2018-01-01', '2019-01-01') if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No 2018 MOD11A1 images.") print("C1") exit() def mask_qc(img): qc = img.select('QC_Day') mask = qc.rightShift(6).bitwiseAnd(3).lte(2) # keep good/average LST return img.updateMask(mask) col = col.map(mask_qc) count = col.first().reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=lut, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if count == 0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") exit() maxLST = col.reduce(ee.Reducer.max()).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=lut, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km_max').getInfo() print(f"2018 max LST: {maxLST:.2f} °C, Valid pixels: {count}") if maxLST is None or maxLST != maxLST or maxLST > 100 or maxLST < -50: print("C3") else: print("A" if maxLST > 75 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

lut = ee.Geometry.Point(58.2, 30.6)  # central Lut Desert
col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1')\
        .filterBounds(lut).filterDate('2018-01-01', '2019-01-01')

if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No 2018 MOD11A1 images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

def mask_qc(img):
    qc = img.select('QC_Day')
    mask = qc.rightShift(6).bitwiseAnd(3).lte(2)  # keep good/average LST
    return img.updateMask(mask)

col = col.map(mask_qc)
count = col.first().reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=lut, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
if count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

maxLST = col.reduce(ee.Reducer.max()).reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=lut, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km_max').getInfo()

print(f"2018 max LST: {maxLST:.2f} °C, Valid pixels: {count}")

if maxLST is None or maxLST != maxLST or maxLST > 100 or maxLST < -50:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if maxLST > 75 else "<answer>B</answer>")
